title: The History of Medieval Assam: From the 13th to the 17th Century
author: Dr. N. N. Acharyya
description: Comprehensive academic treatise on the first four centuries of Tai Ahom rule in Upper Assam, utilizing authentic primary Tai manuscripts and Assamese chronicles. Documents tribal relations with the Chutias, Kacharis, Morans, and Nagas, and the cultural synthesis of the Tai immigrants.
